title: From Doing the Same to Unlocking the New
subtitle: AI isn’t just about doing things faster — it’s about making new things possible.

blocks.title: Automation
blocks.subtitle: AI does the work for you.
blocks.summary: You already know how to do it. AI just executes it.

image.alt: Person at a laptop beside a small AI robot

bullets: Example: AI runs your data pipeline

blocks.title: Efficiency
blocks.subtitle: You do the same, just faster.
blocks.summary: You already know how to do it. AI makes you much more productive.

image.alt: Person and AI robot working together at a laptop

bullets: Same goal, much less time and cost

blocks.title: Opportunity
blocks.subtitle: You can now do what wasn’t possible.
blocks.summary: AI gives you new capabilities, putting previously distant goals within reach.

image.alt: Delighted person at a laptop beside a screen showing a fantasy game world

bullets: New goals that weren’t practical before
Example: A non-3D developer creates a playable game

blocks.title: Example: Creating a 3D Game with AI
Before AI
blocks.subtitle: A promising idea can feel out of reach.

image.alt: Uncertain person facing a laptop while learning 3D game tools

blocks.banner: Learning + building can outweigh the experiment
blocks.description: The idea is interesting, but not practical for most people.

blocks.title: With Efficiency AI
blocks.subtitle: 3D developers do it faster.

image.alt: 3D developer using AI while designing dragon models on a monitor

blocks.description: You still need 3D skills, but can produce assets and scenes faster.

blocks.title: With Opportunity AI
blocks.subtitle: New creators can build 3D games.

image.alt: New game creator viewing a colorful castle world on a screen

blocks.description: You don’t need to be a 3D expert. Idea → describe → playable prototype.

features.title: More innovation
features.text: Ideas once ignored can now be explored.

features.title: More creators
features.text: Capability reaches more people, beyond specialists.

features.title: More software
features.text: More niche tools, games, and personal applications.

features.title: A more creative world
features.text: People can turn imagination into reality.

blocks.title: Key Takeaway
blocks.text: Opportunity AI isn’t just about doing things faster — it gives more people the ability to build a future they couldn’t reach before.

blocks.left: From efficiency to entirely new possibilities.
